professional_summary: Versatile Software Engineer with deep expertise in both Full Stack Web Development and Artificial Intelligence. Proven track record of building beautiful, scalable React and Node.js web applications, as well as designing, training, and deploying large language models (LLMs), RAG systems, and neural networks in production environments.

experience.description: Architected a full-stack internal analytics dashboard using React, TypeScript, and Node.js. Integrated an advanced AI chatbot using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, and vector databases (Pinecone) to allow employees to query internal documents via RAG. Reduced data retrieval time by 80%.

Developed and fine-tuned transformer-based NLP models using PyTorch and HuggingFace for sentiment analysis on customer reviews. Deployed models as high-throughput REST APIs using FastAPI and Docker, serving over 1M requests daily.
Built responsive and performant user interfaces for e-commerce clients using React, Next.js, and TailwindCSS. Implemented complex state management with Redux and integrated Stripe payment gateways.

education.degree: Master of Science in Computer Science (Focus on AI)
